fusions.name: Thunder Barrage
fusions.desc: Fires 4 rounds in a spread, each dealing 4 damage and knocking the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: You charge up to 7 tiles at a target at or below 25% health and fire, dealing 22 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with +10% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Charging Momentum
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
